name: Captain America
summary: The man who punched Hitler before America joined the war. Steve Rogers, a frail kid turned into a peak human soldier, carries a near-indestructible shield and the conscience of the Avengers.
origin: Captain America punched Hitler on his very first cover, and Joe Simon and Jack Kirby meant every bit of it. Captain America Comics #1 hit stands in December 1940 from Timely, the company that grew into Marvel, a full year before Pearl Harbor. Inside, skinny Steve Rogers is turned away by the Army, volunteers for a secret experiment instead, and a super-soldier serum makes him the best a human body can be. Add a near-unbreakable shield, a tactician's brain and old-fashioned decency, and you have the moral centre of the Marvel Universe. Frozen in ice after the war, he was thawed out by the Avengers in 1964 and has been their conscience ever since.
powers: Peak human strength, speed and stamina from the serum
Nearly indestructible shield he can throw and ricochet

storyline.title: The super-soldier
storyline.beat: Frail volunteer Steve Rogers is turned into a peak human soldier by an experimental serum. His first cover shows him punching Adolf Hitler, a full year before the US entered World War II.

storyline.title: Thawed out
storyline.beat: In The Avengers #4, the team finds Cap frozen in ice and revives him. He becomes a man out of time and the heart of the Avengers, while his partner Bucky is said to have died in the war.

storyline.title: Becoming Nomad
storyline.beat: Cap uncovers a conspiracy reaching the top of the US government, loses faith in the role and briefly becomes Nomad, a hero without a country.

storyline.title: Giving up the shield
storyline.beat: Rather than take orders from a government commission, Steve gives up the shield. John Walker becomes Captain America until Steve reclaims the role.

storyline.title: Bucky lives
storyline.beat: Ed Brubaker reveals that Bucky survived the war and was turned into a brainwashed Soviet assassin, the Winter Soldier.

storyline.title: Death of Captain America
storyline.beat: Cap leads the heroes who refuse to register with the government. After surrendering he is shot on the courthouse steps, and Bucky takes up the shield for a time.

storyline.title: Secret Empire
storyline.beat: A reality-altering Cosmic Cube rewrites Steve into a Hydra loyalist, leading to a takeover of the US in the Secret Empire event before the real Steve returns.

gossip.text: That Hitler-punching first cover drew hate mail and threats. Joe Simon later said New York mayor Fiorello La Guardia called to promise the creators police protection.
His first shield was a pointed, badge-shaped one. It became round in issue #2, reportedly because a rival publisher's hero, the Shield, looked too similar.
Cap's shield is made of pure vibranium.
gossip.truth: In the comics it is a one-of-a-kind vibranium-steel alloy created by accident, which is why nobody can copy it.

gossip.text: Marvel revived Cap as a Cold War Commie Smasher in the 1950s. Later stories explained that guy was a different man who took the role.
Bucky Barnes was considered dead in Marvel lore from 1964 until 2005, one of comics' longest-lasting deaths.

quiz.why: Joe Simon and Jack Kirby created him in 1940.

quiz.q: Which team revived Cap from the ice in 1964?
What shape was Cap's very first shield?
quiz.why: The badge-shaped shield was swapped for a round one in issue #2.

theme.tagline: Throws a frisbee. Ends a war.

timeline.title: Punching Hitler on page one
timeline.note: Captain America Comics #1 lands with Cap socking Hitler on the cover, months before America even entered the war. The Red Skull debuts inside.

timeline.title: A wartime movie serial
timeline.note: Republic Pictures turns Cap into a 15-chapter cliffhanger serial, making him the first Marvel hero in live action.

timeline.title: Found frozen in ice
timeline.note: Avengers #4 has the team thaw Steve out of a block of Arctic ice, bringing the golden-age hero into the modern Marvel age.

timeline.title: Becoming Nomad
timeline.note: After the Secret Empire scandal, Captain America #180 has Steve drop the flag and roam as Nomad, a man without a country.

timeline.title: Shot on the courthouse steps
timeline.note: Captain America #25 kills Steve after Civil War, a headline-grabbing death that made the evening news.

timeline.title: Bucky picks up the shield
timeline.note: Captain America #34 makes his old sidekick, now the reformed Winter Soldier, the new Cap.

timeline.title: The First Avenger
timeline.note: Chris Evans plays Steve in Captain America: The First Avenger, a WWII adventure that sets up the Avengers film.

timeline.title: Sam Wilson takes the mantle
timeline.note: An aged-up Steve hands the shield to Sam Wilson, the Falcon, who becomes Captain America in his own right.
